purpose: Cross-domain AB-1 fixture pack for messy input to terrain extraction.

cases.title: Debugging issue with narrow technical symptoms

input.problem_summary: The CSV import is broken after the deploy. We have a confirmed stack trace, the failing path is narrow, and rollback is cheap if the fix is wrong.
input.context: Local script, no stakeholders, fast feedback from the smoke test.

cases.title: GTM search with many possible segments

input.problem_summary: We have five customer segments, limited budget, weak signal, and we are not sure which market to pursue first.
input.context: We need cheap probes because each full campaign is costly to test.

input.problem_summary: The launch is blocked by legal, sales, and support handoffs. Stakeholders keep changing requirements and we need alignment before teams move.
input.context: Approval chain is cross-team and the environment is shifting.

input.problem_summary: The onboarding flow works, but we need to refine and improve conversion over several sprints using live metrics.
input.context: Same-day analytics make feedback fast, and changes are reversible.

cases.title: Agent repeatedly revisits a failed path

input.problem_summary: The agent is stuck in the same failed path and keeps thrashing after false starts. We need to escape the local minimum.
input.context: The environment is otherwise stable, but the current strategy has false confidence.
